# Architecture Errors and Warnings

Messages reported by architecture constraints, such as [ComponentInternal], [InternalImplement] and custom constraints.

| Message | Severity | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <xref:ar0101?text=AR0101> | Warning | A type in another assembly implements an interface marked [InternalImplement]. |
| <xref:ar0102?text=AR0102> | Warning | Code outside of the allowed namespaces or types uses a declaration marked [ComponentInternal]. |
| <xref:ar0104?text=AR0104> | Error | [Internal] is applied to a declaration that is not visible outside of its assembly. |
| <xref:ar0105?text=AR0105> | Warning | Code in another assembly uses a public declaration marked [Internal]. |
| <xref:ar0106?text=AR0106> | Warning | A project uses a declaration marked [Experimental]. |
| <xref:ar0107?text=AR0107> | Error | [Protected] is applied to a declaration that is already private or protected. |
| <xref:ar0108?text=AR0108> | Warning | A type that does not derive from the declaring type uses a declaration marked [Protected]. |
| <xref:ar0109?text=AR0109> | Error | The pattern of a [NamingConvention] constraint is neither a wildcard pattern nor a regular expression. |
| <xref:ar0110?text=AR0110> | Warning | The name of a type does not match the pattern of a [NamingConvention] constraint. |
